title: Gabor Gabor: E-Gaborformer, a Strictly Causal Speech Recognizer with Gabor-Dictionary Convolutions and Delta-Rule Memory
abstract: arXiv:2611.08092v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Real-time voice agents need a speech recognizer that never waits for future audio and whose memory per call does not grow with the length of the call. We present E-Gaborformer, a strictly causal encoder that combines Gated DeltaNet-2 recurrent layers with sliding-window attention in a 3:1 ratio, and builds every temporal convolution from a fixed dictionary of causal Gabor atoms. Its streaming state is constant, about 19 MB per call at production scale including the prediction network, where a causal-attention encoder of the same size accumulates over 1 GB after ten minutes. In a controlled causal study on LibriSpeech, E-Gaborformer leaves the initial plateau earlier, reaches a given accuracy up to 18% sooner, and matches or beats an E-Branchformer trained with the identical front end and recipe. At production scale, a 0.6B-parameter Hebrew and English streaming transducer built on E-Gaborformer has 28 to 31% lower word error rate (WER)

translated_title: Gabor Gabor：E-Gaborformer——采用Gabor字典卷积与Delta规则记忆的严格因果语音识别器
translated_abstract: 实时语音代理需要一种永不等待未来音频、且每次调用内存不随通话时长增长的语音识别器。我们提出E-Gaborformer，这是一种严格因果的编码器，它以3:1的比例将门控DeltaNet-2循环层与滑窗注意力相结合，并且每个时间卷积都由固定的因果Gabor原子字典构建。其流式状态是恒定的，在生产规模下每次调用约19 MB（包括预测网络），而同等规模的因果注意力编码器在十分钟后会累积超过1 GB的内存。在LibriSpeech上的受控因果研究中，E-Gaborformer更早脱离初始平台期，达到给定精度的速度最高提升18%，并能与使用相同前端和训练方案训练的E-Branchformer持平或超越。在生产规模下，基于E-Gaborformer构建的0.6B参数希伯来语和英语流式传感器（transducer）的词错误率（WER）降低了28%至31%。
tldr: E-Gaborformer是一种严格因果的语音识别编码器，通过Gabor字典卷积与Delta规则循环记忆实现恒定约19MB的流式状态（不随通话时长增长），在LibriSpeech上收敛速度最高提升18%，生产规模下词错误率降低28-31%。
en_tdlr: E-Gaborformer is a strictly causal speech recognizer combining Gabor-dictionary convolutions with delta-rule recurrent memory, achieving a constant ~19MB streaming state independent of call length, converging up to 18% faster on LibriSpeech, and reducing WER by 28-31% at production scale.
